players.comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports. Schroder, who missed Friday's game due to what was described as a left thigh injury, has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain. He is set to be reevaluated in two weeks, suggesting he will miss at least the next five games. Christian Anderson and Sion James could see extra minutes with Schroder sidelined.

Allen (concussion-like symptoms) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers. With Allen on the shelf, Royce O'Neale and Christian Anderson should see a boost in minutes off the Hornets' bench. Allen's next chance to suit up will come Friday versus the Hawks.

players.comment: Sengun (eye) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Pacers, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports. Sengun exited the game in the second quarter after taking a shot to the face and will not be able to return. Steven Adams figures to see extra minutes in his absence.

players.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks. Knueppel missed the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign. He returned for the 114-104 loss to Brooklyn on Wednesday, though he exited the contest after just six minutes of work and didn't return. With Knueppel out of commission for at least a month, Grayson Allen and Sion James are candidates to replace him in the starting lineup, especially with Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined for a minimum of two weeks.

Murray-Boyles will not return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to an illness, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports. Murray-Boyles saw just four minutes of action before exiting due to an illness. Allen Graves and Kyle Anderson could see extra minutes with Murray-Boyles sidelined.
